n04f31e0eb2.headline: China: The App That Recreates Your Portrait Is Worth Billions!
n04f31e0eb2.summary: Meitu, a Chinese app offering virtual makeup and photo beautification, is used by 450 million Chinese and valued at 4.2 billion euros.
n04f31e0eb2.why: Meitu is a major player in China's digital consumer market, reflecting the growing value of mobile apps in the technology and social media sectors.
